page.layout: One printed page of running text, with a running head at the top (left "De administrantibus." and right "Lib. 6."), page number 220 centred above. Within the text block a brace diagram in the upper part (Noxgrammatical/Doctrina tradita & praedicata, with braces and the word "per ipsum" at the right), then a second brace diagram (Doctrina tradita est: Generalis & communis / Particularis), then running paragraphs. Right-hand edge shows show-through and a stray column of letters from the facing page, which is not transcribed. Marginal notes: none in a true margin beyond the brace labels.

page.notes: Marginal and brace labels are partly illegible in the scan; the diagram lines are reproduced as best read.
